Estella Ladimar was the headmistress of Westhall Academy in Westruun, Tal'Dorei and a descendant of the heroic wizard Atz Yuminor. As headmistress, she supported the Scions of Yuminor and helps guard the Astural Scrolls.

page.overview:
Who is Estella Ladimar?

Estella Ladimar was the headmistress of Westhall Academy in Westruun, Tal'Dorei and a descendant of the heroic wizard Atz Yuminor. As headmistress, she supported the Scions of Yuminor and helps guard the Astural Scrolls.

So far, Estella Ladimar has not appeared nor been mentioned onstream.
